rules: Nanjing, the night before the autumn provincial examination of 1879; thousands of candidates crowd the inns around the examination compound.
At the fifth watch the examination gate opens; every candidate is searched at it, and one found with a written page is put in the cangue and barred from the examinations for life.
Once inside, candidates are locked in their cells for three days; whoever knows the theme in advance has the examination.
A clerk who leaks the theme is put to death, and the whole examination is cancelled.
Only so many candidates of the province may pass; every place taken is a place lost to someone else.

locations.name: Inn Courtyard
locations.description: The courtyard of a crowded candidates' inn: lamps in every window, a well, young men reciting the classics aloud to calm themselves.

locations.name: Lu Wen's Room
locations.description: A narrow back room with a cold brazier, a cracked inkstone and borrowed books stacked on the bed.

locations.name: Zhao Heng's Rooms
locations.description: The inn's best rooms: silk cushions, a lacquered food box, a padded examination robe laid out on the bed.

locations.name: Bookseller's Stall
locations.description: A stall in the lane outside, open all night in examination week: candles, brushes, and under the counter crib books in tiny print.

locations.name: The Examination Gate
locations.description: The great gate of the compound under torches: soldiers, a line of search tables, and beyond them row upon row of locked cells.

characters.name: Feng Ju
characters.public: A clerk of the examination office, fifty, thin and attentive; candidates bow to him for news of the halls.
characters.voice: Dry and courteous; quotes the regulations, and his threats sound like procedure.
goals: Before the fifth watch, have a finished essay on the true theme sewn into Zhao Heng's robe
Make Lu Wen write it; a crib sheet found in Lu's sleeve at the search is the price of refusing

secrets.text: He copied this year's theme from the chief examiner's envelope while sealing it, and sold it to Zhao's father for fifty taels, to be paid on delivery. [SECRET-FENG-X3]

characters.name: Lu Wen
characters.public: A candidate from the hill country, twenty-eight, on his third attempt; the best essayist at the inn and the poorest.
characters.voice: Formal and bookish, with a hill accent he tries to hide.
goals: Pass on his own essay; his family sold their fields to send him

secrets.text: He sits under his dead cousin's registration, his own having been struck off over unpaid tax; anyone who checks the county register will see it. [SECRET-LU-M6]

characters.name: Zhao Heng
characters.public: A salt merchant's son, nineteen, sitting his first examination; generous, idle, and lodged in the inn's best rooms.
characters.voice: Easy and charming, the slang of the pleasure quarter; flatters when cornered.
goals: Come out of the examination with a pass, so that his father finally leaves him alone

secrets.text: His father gave him fifty taels to pay Feng on delivery; he lost half of it at dice last night. [SECRET-ZHAO-D9]

arc.premise: On the night before the provincial examination, a clerk of the examination office comes to a candidates' inn with a proposal for its poorest guest and its richest.

chapters.goal: Before the gate opens at the fifth watch, the stolen theme costs someone at the inn their place.
